It also covers how long undo stays after commit (UNDO_RETENTION), and why a long report ends with ORA-01555 snapshot too old and what to do about it.
At 3 a.m. a month-end report that ran for two hours ended with ORA-01555. Follow in 10 steps where the old values are kept, and for how long.

두 시간 돌던 월말 보고서가 ORA-01555로 끝났다: A month-end report ran for two hours, then ended with ORA-01555
A month-end sales report started at 1 a.m. and ended with an error at 3:04. Online orders kept arriving all that time, changing the same table. The error is ORA-01555: snapshot too old. There is plenty of disk and every other session is fine.
\"오래된 스냅숏\"이란 무엇일까요? 보고서는 숫자가 중간에 바뀌지 않도: What is an "old snapshot"? The report must see data as of one point in time so its numbers do not shift midway. The material for rebuilding that point in time is undo, and the error means that material is gone. This lesson follows how undo is made, used, and lost.
ORA-01555는 보고서 SQL이 틀려서가 아니라, 보고서가 필요로 한: ORA-01555 is not caused by a wrong report query; it happens because the database had already discarded the old values the report needed. Rerunning may succeed, or fail again.
UPDATE는 고치기 전 값을 Undo에 먼저 남긴다: An UPDATE first keeps the old value in undo
세션 201이 주문 1001의 상태를 <code>NEW</code>에서: Session 201 changes order 1001 from NEW to PAID. Before the block in the buffer cache changes, the old value NEW is written to undo. The Administrator's Guide describes undo as records of the actions of transactions, primarily before they are committed, and says it maintains the before image of the data.
문서가 꼽는 Undo의 쓰임은 다섯 가지입니다. 트랜잭션 롤백, DB 복: The documentation lists five uses of undo: rolling back transactions, database recovery, read consistency, Flashback Query, and recovering from logical corruption (wrongly changed data). A database created with DBCA gets an autoextending UNDOTBS1, and automatic undo management is the default.
\"COMMIT의 여정\" 3장면에서 본 Undo 블록이 바로 이것입니다: This is the undo block you saw in scene 3 of "The journey of a COMMIT". This lesson follows what happens to that undo after the commit.
Session 201 changes its mind and issues ROLLBACK. Oracle writes the old value NEW kept in undo back into the block, undoing the transaction's work in reverse order.
인스턴스가 갑자기 내려간 뒤의 복구도 같은 재료를 씁니다. Concept: Recovery after an instance crash uses the same material. According to Concepts, instance recovery rolls forward with redo and then rolls back uncommitted changes (transaction recovery). That is the work SMON did in scene 7 of "Instance and database".
큰 트랜잭션은 롤백도 오래 걸립니다. 백만 행을 고친 세션을 끊으면, 그: Large transactions also take long to roll back. If you end a session that changed a million rows, its locks stay while those rows are being undone. The KILL in scene 8 of "Locks and waits" releases locks only when the rollback finishes.
쿼리는 시작한 순간(SCN)의 데이터를 본다: A query sees data as of the moment it started (SCN)
새벽 1시, 세션 305가 월말 보고서를 시작합니다. 그 순간 DB의 <: At 1 a.m. session 305 starts the month-end report. At that moment the database SCN (system change number) is 1,000. According to Concepts, under the default READ COMMITTED isolation level, the data a statement returns is committed and consistent for a single point in time: the moment the statement was opened.
그래서 보고서가 두 시간 동안 도는 사이 SCN이 200만을 넘어도, 보: So even if the SCN passes two million while the report runs for two hours, the report adds up only numbers as of SCN 1,000 to the end. Orders committed later and uncommitted changes are both invisible. To pin a whole transaction to one point in time, use the SERIALIZABLE isolation level.
이 성질 덕분에 보고서의 합계는 \"어느 한 순간의 장부\"와 정확히 맞: Thanks to this, a report's totals match the books at exactly one instant. The price is that the undo needed to rebuild that instant must survive until the report ends.
~ 이후 커밋·미커밋 변경은 보이지 않음: ~ later committed or uncommitted changes are invisible
그사이 바뀐 블록은 Undo로 예전 모습을 다시 만든다: A block changed in the meantime is rebuilt as it was, using undo
01시 20분, 세션 201이 주문 1001을 <code>PAID</co: At 1:20, session 201 changed order 1001 to PAID and committed (SCN 1,200). When the report reaches this block, it was changed after the report's SCN of 1,000. Reading it as is would break the single point in time.
Concepts는 이때 DB가 현재 블록을 새 버퍼로 복사하고 Undo를: Concepts explains that the database then copies the current block to a new buffer and applies undo to reconstruct the previous version. This is a CR copy (consistent read clone). The report reads NEW from it. The current block stays untouched, so writers are not blocked either.
블록이 여러 번 바뀌었으면 Undo를 그만큼 거슬러 적용해야 합니다. 바: If a block changed many times, undo must be applied back through all those changes. The longer a report reads a busy table, the further back the undo it needs.
~ Undo 적용 → SCN 1,000 모습(CR 사본): ~ undo applied → as of SCN 1,000 (CR copy)
-- 보고서는 현재 블록이 아니라 CR 사본을 읽는다: -- the report reads the CR copy, not the current block
커밋한 뒤에도 Undo는 한동안 남는다: UNDO_RETENTION: Undo stays for a while even after commit: UNDO_RETENTION
커밋한 트랜잭션의 Undo는 롤백에는 더 필요 없지만, 5장면처럼 오래: Once a transaction commits, its undo is no longer needed for rollback, but long queries like the one in scene 5 still need it. So Oracle keeps committed undo instead of dropping it at once. The documentation calls undo still within the retention period unexpired, and older undo expired. Undo of an active transaction is never overwritten until it commits.
얼마나 남길지의 기준이 <code>UNDO_RETENTION</code>: The setting that governs how long to keep it is UNDO_RETENTION. According to the Database Reference, its default is 900 seconds and it is a low threshold for retention. Under automatic undo management, Oracle tunes the actual retention itself, looking at things like the longest query. But if space runs short, even unexpired undo may be given to new transactions.
고정 크기 Undo 테이블스페이스에서는 오라클이 그 크기로 가능한 최선의: For a fixed-size undo tablespace, Oracle tunes retention to the best it can for that size. The Administrator's Guide says UNDO_RETENTION is then ignored, while the Database Reference says that from Release Update 19.7 at least this value is kept even for fixed-size tablespaces. Judge by your database's RU.
사례: 필요한 Undo가 덮어써지면 ORA-01555: Case: when the needed undo is overwritten, ORA-01555
보고서가 1시간 50분째, 아직 읽지 않은 블록 하나에 닿았습니다. 이: An hour and fifty minutes in, the report reaches a block it has not read yet. The block was changed at 1:05, and only its undo can rebuild it as of SCN 1,000. But the order transactions that came in overnight needed space, and that undo has already been overwritten.
Oracle Error Help의 설명 그대로입니다. 읽는 쪽이 일관된: This is exactly what Oracle Error Help describes: rollback records needed by a reader for consistent read were overwritten by other writers. The writers (orders) all succeeded without error; the only failure is the one long-running report.
ORA-01555의 피해자는 늘 \"오래 읽는 쪽\"입니다. 그래서 신고: The victim of ORA-01555 is always the long reader. That is why reports come from overnight batches, month-end reports and large extracts, not from daytime work.
사례: V$UNDOSTAT으로 보존 기간과 쿼리 길이를 비교한다: Case: compare retention with query length in V$UNDOSTAT
DBA는 먼저 그 시간대에 Undo가 얼마나 남아 있었는지 봅니다. Ad: The DBA first checks how much undo was kept during that time. According to the Administrator's Guide, V$UNDOSTAT shows one row per 10-minute interval for four days (576 rows), and the TUNED_UNDORETENTION column holds the retention Oracle tuned, in seconds. Records older than four days are in AWR's DBA_HIST_UNDOSTAT.
새벽 1~3시 구간의 보존 기간이 3,000초 안팎인데 보고서는 6,80: Retention between 1 and 3 a.m. was around 3,000 seconds, but the report ran for 6,800 seconds. Undo did not survive as long as the report needed. The view also records the length and SQL ID of long-running queries.
Undo Advisor(EM Express나 DBMS_ADVISOR)도: The Undo Advisor (EM Express or DBMS_ADVISOR) uses the same AWR data to work out how much undo is needed to keep a given retention.
사례: 보존 기간을 늘리고, 그만큼 공간을 준다: Case: raise retention, and give it the space to match
Oracle Error Help의 조치는 자동 Undo 관리라면 <cod: Oracle Error Help's action is to increase undo_retention under automatic undo management, and the Oracle tutorial says to increase the retention or the size of the undo tablespace. If the report runs about 7,000 seconds, set retention comfortably above that and give enough space for the undo that piles up in that time.
<code>RETENTION GUARANTEE</code>를 켜면 문서대: With RETENTION GUARANTEE, as the documentation says, Oracle never overwrites unexpired undo even if transactions fail. The report is protected, but if space runs short, the order DML fails instead. It is disabled by default; turn it on only after deciding business priorities.
보고서 쪽에서 할 수 있는 일도 있습니다. 바쁜 시간을 피해 돌리거나,: There is also work on the report side: run it outside busy hours, or tune the SQL so it finishes sooner, and less undo is needed at all. Adding space to the undo tablespace works like the tablespace lesson in DBA labs stage 3.
정리: Undo는 되돌리기와 한 시점 읽기의 재료: Recap: undo is the material for undoing and for reading one point in time
DML은 고치기 전 값을 Undo에 남깁니다. ROLLBACK과 인스턴스: DML keeps the old values in undo. ROLLBACK and instance recovery apply it in reverse, and queries use it to build CR copies as of their starting SCN. That is why readers and writers do not block each other.
커밋된 Undo는 UNDO_RETENTION과 자동 조정에 따라 한동안: Committed undo stays for a while, per UNDO_RETENTION and automatic tuning, then is overwritten. If it is kept for less time than the longest query, ORA-01555 follows. Compare retention with query length in V$UNDOSTAT, and adjust retention and space together.
Undo is not just scratch space for rollback; it is the basis of read consistency. The CR copy in this lesson is why the query in scene 4 of "Locks and waits" was not blocked.
